CustomField.description: Domain for the synthetic signer address, which DocuSign requires even for embedded signing. No ADHA applicant has an email address, so the signer is wb-[application number]@[this domain]: unique per person so the audit trail stays meaningful, and undeliverable so nothing can leak out by email. Must not be a domain that accepts mail. Must also be added to the SELECT in ADHA_JourneyController.settings() or it reads as null.
CustomField.label: Signer Email Domain
